9.1.4
> For thick client applications, verify that the app either uses its own certificate store, or pins the endpoint certificate or public key, and will not establish connections with endpoints that offer a different certificate or key, even if signed by a trusted CA.

Based on #803, is this requirement 9.1.4 still in scope?

If it stays in scope, it would be nice to rewording it the way, it starts with "Verify that" or "Verify" like all other requirements.
